# SampaUI Agent Guide

SampaUI is a Blade-first UI package for Laravel 13+, Livewire 4+, Tailwind CSS 4, AlpineJS and Bootstrap Icons. It is intended for corporate, real estate and SaaS applications with a premium, restrained visual style.

Official docs to consult when changing package, Laravel or Livewire behavior:
- https://laravel.com/docs/13.x/documentation
- https://laravel.com/docs/13.x/packages
- https://livewire.laravel.com/docs/4.x/quickstart
- https://livewire.laravel.com/docs/4.x/forms

## Installation

```bash
composer require sampaui/sampaui
php artisan sampaui:install
npm run build
```

The installer publishes config/assets and imports:

```css
@import "../../vendor/sampaui/sampaui/dist/sampaui.css";
```

```js
import "../../vendor/sampaui/sampaui/dist/sampaui.js";
```

## Public API Rules

- Component namespace: `sampaui`.
- Component tag format: `<x-sampaui::{slug} />`.
- All components must accept `class=""` customization.
- Form components must preserve `wire:model` and Livewire modifiers on the real control.
- Interactive components must preserve `wire:click`, `wire:navigate`, `x-*` and valid HTML attributes.
- Form borders use `border-secondary/40`.
- Prefer official semantic tokens over custom hex classes.
- Use Bootstrap Icons only, with `bi bi-{name}` classes.

## Theme Tokens

Official tokens:

```txt
primary, secondary, accent, danger, light, success, warning, info, purple, muted
```

Common classes:

```txt
bg-primary, text-secondary, border-light, bg-accent/10, focus:ring-primary/20
```

## Component Registry

The source of truth for agents and docs is:

```txt
resources/metadata/components.php
```

The static export is:

```txt
docs/registry/components.json
```

Use this command to export:

```bash
php artisan sampaui:docs-export --format=json --path=docs/registry/components.json
```

## Agent Commands

```bash
php artisan sampaui:about
php artisan sampaui:list
php artisan sampaui:list --category=form
php artisan sampaui:doctor
php artisan sampaui:docs-export --format=json
php artisan sampaui:docs-export --format=markdown
```

## Masked Fields

`phone`, `currency-br` and `cep` format values internally with Alpine inline handlers. They do not require an external Alpine mask plugin.

Examples:

```blade
<x-sampaui::phone name="phone" label="Telefone" wire:model.live="phone" />
<x-sampaui::currency-br name="price" label="Valor" wire:model.live="price" />
<x-sampaui::cep name="postal_code" label="CEP" wire:model.live="postal_code" />
```

`cep` formats `12345678` as `12345-678`.

## New Component Checklist

When adding or changing a component, update:

- `resources/views/components/{slug}.blade.php`
- `resources/metadata/components.php`
- `docs/{slug}.md`
- `docs/components.md`
- `docs/registry/components.json`
- `llms-full.txt`
- tests in `tests/Feature`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

Before release:

```bash
composer test
npm run build
git diff --check
```
